title: Ridgepost Capital and NYSE Texas Co-Host Dallas CFO Event
summary: Ridgepost Capital recently co-hosted a CFO event with NYSE Texas, bringing together finance leaders from family offices, private equity firms, and venture capital firms across the region.
body_markdown:
Ridgepost Capital recently co-hosted a CFO event with NYSE Texas, bringing together finance leaders from family offices, private equity firms, and venture capital firms across the region. The event provided an opportunity for participants to exchange perspectives on the evolving private markets landscape and strengthen relationships across the region’s financial services community.
